subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama setup enforce an unconditional one-hour maximum pull duration, or only terminate a stream that stops making meaningful model-download progress?
rationale: Both choices prevent infinite drip hangs, but only maintainers can confirm whether a fixed maximum duration is an intended product contract for large models and slow or remote Ollama hosts.

options.title: Use a progress watchdog
options.body: Reset the existing stall budget only when Ollama status or completed-byte progress advances, allowing valid long pulls while rejecting meaningless drip.

options.title: Approve the one-hour cap
options.body: Keep the wall-clock deadline only with explicit product approval, long-pull upgrade proof, and a decision on whether the limit belongs in the public API.

options.title: Pause the timeout change
options.body: Leave the current idle-only behavior until a compatible progress-aware design and its validation are ready.

recommendation.title: Use a progress watchdog
recommendation.body: Reset the existing stall budget only when Ollama status or completed-byte progress advances, allowing valid long pulls while rejecting meaningless drip.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice defines provider onboarding behavior and the acceptable Ollama plugin API contract.
